title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-05
source: Reel To Reel > CD Burner > Roxio Sound Editor > Wav > WavePad > Flac16

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording captures a magical early‑1970 show, opening strong with China Cat Sunflower and sustaining the energy through to an engaging encore.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, noting a powerful start with China Cat Sunflower that carries momentum all the way through the final encore. The audience source is described as unusually clear—so crisp it even outshines an existing soundboard version—while still preserving just enough crowd ambience to feel immersive.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the surprisingly high fidelity of the audience recording, indicating an exceptional show with excellent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Extremely clear for an audience tape; faint crowd noise adds ambience but does not muddy the mix. No reported dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening that maintains energy throughout, with engaging banter and a satisfying encore; overall flow described as immersive and consistently enjoyable.
